_comment: Copy to globalconfig.json (gitignored) for standalone `docker compose up`. Every real secret (ConnectionStrings/RabbitMq credentials) is already supplied directly as plain environment variables in docker-compose.yml for local dev, so this file only needs to satisfy AddKartGlobalConfig's fail-fast Path requirement - a real deployed environment points GlobalConfig__Path at the actual shared kart-internals/globalconfig.json instead, which layers real secrets under Services.kart-shipping-service.
